user.title: Choose media bridge
user.description: Choose the provider-specific private Rust bridge.

bridge.title: Connect to bridge
bridge.description: The API token authenticates Home Assistant to the private bridge. Vendor credentials are not stored in this entry.

ring_credentials.title: Enroll Ring account
ring_credentials.description: Credentials are sent once to the private bridge and are never saved by Home Assistant.

otp.title: Verify Ring SMS
otp.description: Enter the six-digit SMS code. The challenge is single-use, including after an incorrect code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure bridge
reconfigure.description: Update local bridge access without changing the vendor-owned session.

error.cannot_connect_restart: Verification could not complete. Start a fresh enrollment.
error.invalid_url: Enter a plain HTTP or HTTPS bridge URL without credentials or paths.
error.invalid_bridge_auth: The bridge API token is invalid.
error.invalid_otp_restart: Ring rejected the code. Start a fresh enrollment; the old challenge was consumed.
error.enrollment_busy: Another enrollment is active on this bridge.
error.enrollment_expired: The enrollment expired or was consumed. Start again.
error.rate_limited: The bridge or Ring is rate limiting enrollment. Wait before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This bridge device is already configured.
